name: Validate epigenetic clocks as an intervention surrogate inside an existing trial

design.model: participants in an ongoing randomised trial with a clinical endpoint (any intervention plausibly age-related)
design.intervention: none additional: methylation measured at baseline, 6 and 12 months
design.readout: whether early clock change predicts the trial's pre-registered clinical endpoint, within and across arms

discriminates: If early clock movement predicts the clinical endpoint, clocks become a usable surrogate and every rejuvenation trial gets shorter; if it does not, the field's main endpoint is invalid and the map should regrade accordingly.

requires: an existing trial willing to add methylation sampling
feasibility.ethics: amendment to the host trial's approval

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
